name: ToxMania
description:
ToxMania – player-driven Survival SMP for Bedrock & Java

Join: toxmania.net · Port 19132

Claims that really protect

Claim your land in any shape you like. Inside your claim nobody can break, take or fight – not even staff. Outside of claims the wilderness is PvP and anything goes.

A real player economy

Sell your items on the player market, open your own chest shop, place buy orders and bounties, earn dollars and climb the leaderboards.

Guilds

Found a guild with a shared bank, taxes, bankers, road builders and build contracts.

Play together

Bedrock and Java on the same world, proximity voice chat and in-game rewards for being active on our Discord.

No fixed spawn – you start at a random spot in the world, so everyone gets a fair start.

We are in beta – come early and help shape the server!

www.toxmania.net
